components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one filled orange action per view (Start audit, Rescan, Mark resolved).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary{font-family:var(--font-family, Manrope, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif);font-size:13px;font-weight:700;padding:9px 16px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid transparent;background:var(--color-primary-strong,#c2490a);color:#fff;cursor:pointer;transition:background .12s ease,transform .08s ease}.ds-btn-primary:hover{background:var(--color-primary-strong-hover,#a83d08)}.ds-btn-primary:active{transform:translateY(1px)}.ds-btn-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--color-focus,#c2490a);outline-offset:2px}.ds-btn-primary:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed}

components.name: Issue Row
components.description: Checkbox plus card button; selected is Orange Tint with a full ring, never a side stripe.
components.css: .ds-row{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:flex-start;width:420px}.ds-row input{margin:14px 0 0;width:16px;height:16px;accent-color:var(--color-primary-strong,#c2490a)}.ds-issue{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;text-align:left;padding:16px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--color-border,#e5e5e7);background:var(--color-surface,#fff);color:var(--color-text,#17181a);font-family:var(--font-family, Manrope, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif);cursor:pointer}.ds-issue:hover{background:var(--color-surface-alt,#f7f7f8)}.ds-issue.ds-selected{background:var(--color-primary-soft,#fdeee3);border-color:var(--color-primary-text,#b83f06);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--color-primary-text,#b83f06)}.ds-line{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center}.ds-badge-c{padding:3px 8px;border-radius:999px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;background:var(--color-critical-soft,#fef1f0);color:var(--color-critical-text,#c4271b)}.ds-title{font-size:13px;font-weight:700}.ds-desc{font-size:12px;color:var(--color-text-secondary,#58585c)}.ds-meta{font-size:11px;color:var(--color-text-tertiary,#6b6b70)}.ds-issue:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--color-focus,#c2490a);outline-offset:2px}

narrative.overview:
DesignLens is a measuring instrument that lives inside someone else's file. It looks the way a good inspection report reads: neutral surfaces, plain bordered containers, small precise type, and numbers and statuses doing the talking. The interface is deliberately quiet so that the findings are the loudest thing on screen.

Color is rationed and each hue has one job. Orange is the brand and the action; status never borrows it. Critical, warning, suggestion and success each have their own hue, a soft tint, and a darker text step that clears AA. Depth is almost absent: surfaces are flat and separated by hairlines, and only things that genuinely float leave the page.

The system is precise, calm and trustworthy. It rejects loud SaaS marketing-dashboard energy, gamified scoring, and decorative gradients or glass.
keyCharacteristics: Flat, bordered, softly rounded surfaces; one filled orange button marks the primary action.
Orange means brand and action only; severity and score use their own hues.
Every text color has an AA-passing step; vivid fills are for graphics and large marks.
Six-step type scale in a single variable face (Manrope), heavy weights for hierarchy, tabular numerals for data.
Light and dark themes share one token set; dark is defined in exactly one block.
Fully keyboard-operable with a single visible focus ring.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Orange means brand and action. It never encodes status, severity or score; a score that needs work is Amber, not orange, so it can never be mistaken for a button.

rules.name: The AA-or-It-Doesn't-Ship Rule
rules.body: Any color used as text comes from a -text step (or Graphite/Slate/Ash). Vivid fills are for bars, dots, rings and large marks only. A contrast auditor cannot fail contrast.

rules.name: The Not-By-Color-Alone Rule
rules.body: Status is always paired with a word or glyph, never hue alone.

rules.name: The Six-Step Rule
rules.body: Font sizes come from --text-xs/sm/base/md/lg/xl (11/12/13/15/18/24). There are no half-pixel or one-off sizes; a test fails the build if a raw size appears.

rules.name: The Weight-Over-Size Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is made with weight before size. Resolved and ignored items recede by color, never by opacity, so their text keeps its contrast.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. A shadow appears only on elements that float above the page or in direct response to state, never as decoration on a card.

dos: Do use Ember Fill (#c2490a) for any filled orange surface that carries white text, and Ember Text (#b83f06) for orange type.
Do keep orange to brand and action: one primary button per view, the wordmark, the selected row, the active nav item.
Do pair every status color with a label or glyph, and use the -text step whenever the color is read as type.
Do size type from the six --text-* tokens and build hierarchy with weight first.
Do separate surfaces with 1px Hairline borders; lift only what floats.
Do give every interactive element the global 2px focus ring, keep full keyboard operation, and honor prefers-reduced-motion.
Do keep Paper/Fog/Hairline/Graphite relationships identical in both themes by remapping tokens, never by adding per-component dark overrides.
Do animate progress with transform, not width, and keep transitions to 80–200ms.
donts: Don't use Lens Orange (#ee661d) as text or for score, severity or "needs attention" meaning.
Don't put shadows on cards or nest cards inside cards.
Don't mark selection with a one-sided colored stripe; use the full ring over Orange Tint.
Don't dim resolved or ignored content with opacity; change its color and weight instead.
Don't introduce gradients, glass or blur, decorative illustrations, or gamified celebration.
Don't add a new font size, radius, or text color outside the scales above.
Don't convey status by hue alone, and don't use the vivid status fills for small text.
Don't fetch anything at runtime: fonts, icons and scripts are inlined, because the plugin has no network access.
